candidate_sentences.text: Net sales increased by 11.1 percent to SEK 131.5 million, compared with SEK 118.4 million in the previous year.

Consequently, the operating profit improved only modestly in absolute terms but remained negative, reporting a loss of SEK 1.9 million compared to a loss of SEK 9.7 million in the prior year.

The Board of Directors proposed no dividend for the 2025 fiscal year, citing the need to preserve capital and focus on balance sheet strength amid external economic uncertainties.
